title: the human maintainer's BUG-14 fix lands
description: Lands fix/bug-14 (ff194c30, aad1aa87, 536f017a, e3afc4ae, bbc0be38), already reviewed clean across four rounds by the orchestrator's audit-reviewer agent. The fix is the human maintainer's; this phase's own work is the landing bookkeeping (SECURITY.md, bug close, review record, sign-off, merge) - no new guard code is written in this phase.
desiredOutcome: BUG-14 is closed: every guard that could not place a cd/pushd/popd/-C target, or that treated a missing payload cwd as evidence the shell never moved, now answers unplaceable rather than falling back to the session

tasks.title: BUG-14's fix lands, and SECURITY.md, the CHANGELOG and the bug record describe it
tasks.description:
Merge branch fix/bug-14 (ff194c30, aad1aa87, 536f017a, e3afc4ae, bbc0be38 - the
maintainer's fix, reviewed clean across four rounds) into this phase's branch.
Then correct the documents to what the code does: SECURITY.md gains the
unplaceable-target behaviour (a cd/pushd/popd/-C target that cannot be read
now answers unplaceable rather than falling back to the session or project),
and that a payload naming no cwd at all is judged by whether the command
moves the shell, not treated as evidence it did not. The CHANGELOG entry
says the same. Complete the BUG-14 record: taskId this task, fixedIn the
fixing commit, the full files list, a note recording the four review rounds
and that BUG-15 (guard-release's heredoc-blind _shell_moves, found during
round 4) is filed separately rather than folded into this bug, since it is
a different file and a different, pre-existing defect. Gate: the history
guard suite, the full sweep, bench-hooks --gate, check-committed-pii.
